{{CharInfobox| color={{poison color}} | corecolor={{poison color light}} | bordercolor={{poison color dark}} | name=Aya | jname=アヤ| tmname=Aya| text=white| slogan=no | image=Aya anime.png | size=250px | caption=Aya in {{aniseries|GS}} | colors=yes| eyes=Blue | hair=Green | gender=Female | hometown=[[Fuchsia City]] | region=[[Kanto]] | trainer=yes | trainerclass=Unknown | relatives=[[Koga]] (brother) | game=no | leader=no | team=no | brain=no | anime=yes | epnum=EP032 | epname=The Ninja Poké-Showdown | enva=[[Lisa Ortiz]]| java=Emi Shinohara| }} '''Aya''' (Japanese: '''アヤ''' ''Aya'') is a ninja and a [[Pokémon Trainer]] who specializes in {{type|Poison}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. She is the younger sister of [[Koga]], the [[Fuchsia City]] [[Gym Leader]], and is a student of the [[Gym]]. Apparently, she was raised by Koga since she was young. She also has an interest in poetry. ==In animation== [[File:Aya and Koga.png|200px|thumb|left|Aya and Koga]] ===History=== ===={{aniseries|OS}}==== Aya debuted in ''[[EP032|The Ninja Poké-Showdown]]'', where she encountered {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, and {{an|Brock}} in the [[Fuchsia Gym]]. Aya challenged Ash to a {{pkmn|battle}} with her {{p|Venonat}} and Ash agreed, sending out {{AP|Bulbasaur}}. He won the match easily with his Bulbasaur's {{m|Leech Seed}}. After the battle, her older brother [[Koga]] appeared. After seeing {{TP|Misty|Psyduck}}'s performance in defeating {{TRT}}, Aya offered her Venonat to {{an|Misty}}, who promptly declined the offer. Soon after, Aya watched Ash and Koga battle and after Ash's victory, decided with her brother that both should train more and more. ===={{aniseries|GS}}==== Aya reappeared in ''[[EP176|Ariados, Amigos]]'', where she was training at the [[Pokémon Jujitsu Academy]] to learn Pokémon {{wp|Jujitsu}}. She and her {{p|Venonat}} were unable to master it; she even faced Ash and his Bulbasaur in a [[rematch]] and lost. After an encounter with {{TRT}}, she was able to bring out her Venonat's full potential and defeat them. She then returned to the dojo to fully master Pokémon Jujitsu. ===Character=== Aya is set on becoming a ninja warrior, thus she trains and studies intensely to fulfill that goal. Her time at the [[Pokémon Jujitsu Academy]] has taught her to turn her weaknesses into her strengths, and she relies on her {{p|Venonat}}'s [[status move]]s to overcome tough opponents. ===Pokémon=== This listing is of Aya's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Aya |pkmn=Venonat |type1=Bug |type2=Poison |img=Aya Venonat.png |epnum=EP032 |epname=The Ninja Poké-Showdown |vajp=Rikako Aikawa |vaen=Rachael Lillis |desc=While trying to find their way through the [[Fuchsia Gym]], {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} encountered Aya, who challenged Ash to a {{pkmn|battle}}. During the battle, Aya used Venonat against [[Ash's Bulbasaur]]. Eventually, Bulbasaur was able to defeat Venonat with its {{m|Leech Seed}}. Aya also tried to use Venonat to battle against {{TRT}}, but was tied up by a sticky net cast by [[James]] and [[Jessie]]. Venonat reappeared in Ash's flashback in ''[[EP073|Bad To The Bone]]'', when he remembered how he obtained his [[Gym]] [[Badge]]s. In ''[[EP176|Ariados, Amigos]]'', Aya used Venonat in a [[rematch]] against Ash, who used Bulbasaur again. Like before, Venonat lost the battle. It was also later used to battle and defeat Team Rocket who had stolen [[Poké Ball]]s from the dojo. [[Jessie]], [[James]] and {{MTR}} get trapped in [[Koga]]'s [[Fuchsia Gym|Gym]] while searching for the [[Hidden Village]] with {{OBP|Ash's Pikachu|EToP}}, a {{p|Charmander}}, a {{p|Squirtle}}, a {{p|Kangaskhan}} and {{OBP|Tommy|EP034}}. She appears in the background during Team Rocket's battle with Koga. Their battle is only shown briefly in a montage sequence and it is unknown whether Team Rocket was victorious or not.
